Advanced engineering elevates the driving experience even further with adaptive suspension, four-wheel independent suspension, Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Following Assist, Auto High-Beam Headlights, and a comprehensive suite of Genesis safety technologies. Whether cruising on the highway or navigating city streets, the G90 delivers exceptional ride quality, precise handling, and confidence-inspiring control.

Recognized as MotorTrend's Automobile of the Year, the G90 has earned acclaim for its extraordinary combination of luxury, innovation, performance, and value.

Blue Certified and aggressively styled from the factory, this 2022 Toyota Camry TRD V6 delivers thrilling naturally aspirated V6 performance, sport-tuned handling, bold TRD appearance upgrades, and legendary Toyota reliability in one of the most exciting midsize sedans on the road today. Finished in striking Midnight Black Metallic with the highly desirable two-tone black roof over a Black interior with red TRD sport accents, this Camry combines sharp styling, athletic driving dynamics, and everyday practicality into a sedan that feels far more performance-focused than traditional family cars. With 63,938 miles, this Camry TRD continues to showcase why Toyota’s performance-inspired TRD lineup has become so highly respected among enthusiasts and daily drivers alike.

Under the hood sits Toyota’s outstanding 3.5L DOHC 24-valve V6 engine paired to a responsive 8-speed Direct Shift automatic transmission with paddle shifters and sequential sport-shift capability. This naturally aspirated V6 powertrain delivers exhilarating acceleration, smooth high-rpm performance, and a deep performance-oriented exhaust note while still maintaining excellent reliability and impressive fuel economy ratings of approximately 22 MPG city and 32 MPG highway. Whether commuting through Tampa traffic, cruising throughout Wesley Chapel and Clearwater, or enjoying Florida backroads, this Camry TRD delivers an engaging and surprisingly athletic driving experience.

The TRD package completely transforms the Camry’s appearance and handling characteristics. The Midnight Black Metallic exterior paired with the black contrast roof creates a dramatic and aggressive look while the TRD-exclusive front splitter, rear diffuser, aerodynamic rocker extensions, black grille, rear spoiler, sport exhaust system, and aggressive body styling help create a commanding road presence throughout Brandon, Riverview, Tampa, and the surrounding Tampa Bay area.

Toyota Racing Development also significantly upgraded the suspension tuning to enhance handling and responsiveness. The TRD sport-tuned suspension, front and rear anti-roll bars, larger brakes, and specially calibrated steering system combine to create a sedan that feels composed, sharp, and confidence-inspiring during spirited driving while still maintaining comfortable everyday road manners.

Inside the cabin, the Camry TRD blends sporty design with impressive comfort and practicality. Black seating surfaces with red sport accents, leather-wrapped steering wheel, paddle shifters, aluminum-style interior trim, red contrast stitching, sport pedals, dual-zone automatic climate control, and TRD-exclusive styling details create a performance-inspired interior atmosphere that feels far more premium than expected in the midsize sedan segment.

Technology remains another major strength of this Camry TRD. Equipped with Toyota’s premium infotainment systems and the highly desirable TRD Premium Audio package with JBL audio, this sedan includes upgraded premium sound quality, Bluetooth connectivity, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, intelligent driver information systems, multiple connectivity options, and modern infotainment functionality designed to keep drivers seamlessly connected while on the road.

Passenger comfort and practicality remain excellent despite the TRD’s performance focus. Spacious rear seating accommodations, front and rear center armrests, dual-zone climate control with rear console ducts, multiple storage compartments, large trunk space, and foldable rear seat functionality help make this Camry highly usable for commuting, road trips, groceries, and everyday driving needs.

When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. Touted as one of the best small sedans by critics, this sharp looking and low mileage vehicle always seems to sell quickly. Thank you for your interest in our 2025 Honda Civic Hybrid Sport acquired with 22,814 miles. This vehicle is still covered under the remaining balance of the Factory 3 Year/36,000-mile Bumper-to-Bumper & 5 Year/60,000-mile Limited Powertrain Warranties! KEY POINTS ABOUT THIS Civic While marketed as a small traditional family sedan, this Civic is equipped with the Sport Trim and add a bit of flair over other trims in the lineup. Additionally, it appears that the suspension has been lowered slightly and dark tint on the windows help to make the Aegean Blue Metallic exterior paint really pop! It is still powered by a 2.0L 4-cyl. engine w/an electric motor and a CVT automatic transmission. While factory tuning has it at 200 HP and 232 lb-ft. of torque. All four tires still have ample tread for easy steering, a smooth ride and excellent traction. The cabin is very clean and with so few miles, needs to be considered to be in excellent condition! As mentioned above, the Sport trim has more flair to it than just about any other trim for the Civic. While being a step above the base LX, the Sport trim specifically added or enhanced the experience with 18-inch alloy wheels, remote ignition via the key fob, keyless entry, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shifter, ambient cabin lighting, plus an eight-speaker audio system, a sunroof, dual-zone automatic climate controls & heated front seats. Based upon information from Honda, everything else is standard equipment. Highlights to some of additional features include: Safety and Security
  • Forward collision warning with automatic braking (warns you of an impending collision and applies the brakes in certain scenarios)
  • Lane keeping assistance (steers the Civic back into its lane if it begins to drift over the lane marker)
  • Adaptive cruise control (adjusts speed to maintain a constant distance between the Civic and the vehicle in front)

The 2025 Kia K5 GT-Line with All-Wheel Drive (AWD) is a different beast tailored for the El Pasoan who wants maximum confidence. In a city where we deal with sand-slicked roads, sudden monsoon downpours, and winter trips to the mountains, the AWD K5 is the "all-weather" athlete of the sedan world. Desert Traction: El Paso roads are notorious for being slick during the first 10 minutes of rain because of built-up oil and fine desert dust. The AWD system automatically redistributes power to the wheels with the most grip, keeping you stable on I-10 or Loop 375. The New Engine: For 2025, Kia ditched the old 1.6L turbo for a more powerful 2.5L 4-cylinder engine producing 191 horsepower. It feels more substantial and "line-ready" when you're trying to merge into fast-moving traffic. Mountain Ready: If you frequently head up to Ruidoso or Cloudcroft for the weekend, the AWD provides that extra peace of mind on snowy inclines that a standard sedan simply can't match. Heated Steering Wheel: Exclusive to the AWD package. While it sounds unnecessary in Texas, anyone who has gripped a freezing steering wheel on a January morning in Cimarron or Horizon City will tell you its a game-changer. Remote Start with Climate Control: Using the Kia Access app, you can start the car from your phone while you're still inside the Fountains at Farah. By the time you get to the car, the seats are cool and the A/C is humming. LED "Star Map" Lighting: The updated 2025 amber daytime running lights aren't just for style they pierce through El Pasos spring dust storms (haboobs) much better than standard white bulbs. Curved Panoramic Display: You get a massive 12.3-inch touchscreen that is angled toward the driver. It features Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as standard. Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates: The car can now update its own software via the cloud. This means your navigation maps for the ever-changing construction at the "Spaghetti Bowl" stay current without a trip to the dealer. GT-Line Styling: You get the sporty flat-bottom steering wheel and SynTex (synthetic leather) seats with GT-Line embroidery. They are durable, easy to clean, and hold up well against the intense UV rays of West Texas. Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance: Essential for those wide-lane shifts on the North-South Freeway (US-54). Forward Collision-Avoidance (Junction Turning): A new 2025 feature that can detect oncoming cars when you are making a left turn at a busy intersection (like Zaragoza and Saul Kleinfeld). Safe Exit Assist: Prevents passengers from opening the door if the car senses a vehicle or cyclist approaching from behind perfect for street parking downtown. Buying a used car doesn't have to be a cause for worry. Casa fully inspects all the vehicles that make it to our lot, so we stand behind them. Your pre-owned vehicle is covered the moment you drive off the Casa lot. We understand that your vehicle is a significant investment, and we want to make sure that you get the most out of it.
